question: Who was the first Indian woman wrestler to win a medal at the Olympics?
solution: The Correct answer is **Sakshi Malik.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Sakshi Malik **was the first Indian Women Wrestler to win Medal in Olympics. • She won this medal **in 2016 Olympics held in Rio de Janeiro**. • She won the Bronze medal in **56 kg weight freestyle wrestling category.** • She had honoured with Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award **(**presently known as **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award) **and **Padma Shri in 2017.**
